question: What is the meaning of warnings in relation to material health?
description: Warnings in relation to material health indicate the presence of substances that may pose health risks, such as carcinogens, mutagens, or endocrine disruptors. These warnings are crucial for ensuring the safety and well-being of individuals who come into contact with the materials. They also play a role in regulatory compliance and the promotion of sustainable and healthy building practices.
